latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — comprehensive Amazon seller intelligence tool.

- Scrapes Amazon bestseller lists, competitor ASINs, review databases, pricing histories, keyword rankings, and seller profiles with 10 dedicated Apify scrapers.
- Builds detailed Amazon market intelligence reports to identify high-demand, low-competition products before saturation.
- Reverse-engineers strategies of top sellers and maps review gaps for product positioning.
- Finds untapped keyword opportunities competitors are missing.
- Automates buyer outreach and review generation via GetResponse.
- Designed for Amazon FBA sellers, Shopify brands, agencies, and anyone selling on Amazon.
